# TimeSplitters: Future Perfect

## What does randomization do to this game?

All 48 Arcade League missions and Challenges, all 13 story levels, all 150 characters, the 13
cheats and 34 arcade weapons are locked until you receive them from the multiworld. All three
Arcade Leagues are open from the beginning, so any mission can be unlocked at any time. You start
with one or more missions (chosen by the Starting Mission options), one random character and one
random weapon.

Nothing unlocks the normal way any more. Beating a story level does not open the next one: if
you do not have it, the game returns to the level select. Characters, cheats and weapons are
never needed to reach a check; they unlock for the Gallery, the Cheats menu and Arcade Custom.

Only the North American GameCube version (game ID `G3FE69`) is supported.

## What are the checks?

* Trophies: a Bronze, Silver, Gold or Platinum trophy on a mission sends a check for that trophy
  and every lower one.
* Story levels: completing a level on Easy, Normal and Hard are three checks (finishing on Hard
  also counts Normal and Easy, as in the normal game).
* Story objectives: each listed objective is one check, on any difficulty, at the moment the game
  marks it complete. Some are hidden objectives the game never shows on screen.
* Milestones (each can be switched off in the options): "AL - One Gun Fun - Group Completed" and
  the like for a Bronze or better on all three missions of a group, "Amateur / Honorary / Elite
  League Completed" for all nine missions of a league, and "All Challenges Completed".
* Archipelago Shop (if switched on): "Archipelago Shop Item 1" to 15, 30, 45, 60 or 75, bought with
  points in the game (see Archipelago Shop below).

Your first trophy on Rockets 101 being a Platinum sends four checks. 1924 Future Perfect has no
objective checks.

## What is the goal?

Chosen in your options:

* 1924 Future Perfect (default): complete 1924 Future Perfect on any difficulty. It opens once you
  have it AND have completed the chosen number of other story levels (0 to 12; Future Perfect
  itself never counts) AND have the chosen number of Arcade League missions or Challenges at the
  chosen trophy grade or better (0 to 48). Completing it is the goal, not a check.
* Trophy Hunt: earn the chosen grade of trophy or better on every Arcade League mission, every
  Challenge, or all 48. With this goal, completing 1924 Future Perfect on each difficulty is three
  ordinary checks.

## Items

* Story levels are named by year, for example "2401 Time To Split". With the Progressive Story
  Level option they are replaced by 13 "Progressive Story Level" items that open the levels in order.
* Cheats are named "<cheat> Unlock", for example "Fat Characters Unlock", and are Useful items.
  The unused cheats
  (Infinite Ammo, Skating and one hidden entry) are left alone.
* Arcade weapons are named "<weapon> Unlock", for example "Pistol 9mm Unlock". A weapon can only
  be picked for a custom weapon set once you have it, and its (x2) version comes with it. You
  start with one random weapon. Unarmed is always available, and the hidden weapons are not in
  the pool. Weapons and characters are filler.
* "Progressive Behead The Undead Score Multiplier" (up to three, if switched on): each one
  multiplies the points for every kill in Brain Drain, Rare Or Well Done? and Boxing Clever, up to
  x4. It needs Dolphin's cheat codes (Config > General > Enable Cheats) to be off.
* "Progressive Miscellaneous Challenges Score Multiplier" (up to three, if switched on): the
  same for the points you score in Cortez Can't Jump!, TSUG: TimeSplitters Underground and Plainly
  Off His Rocker, up to x4. It also needs Dolphin's cheat codes to be off.
* "Progressive Starting Armour" (up to four, if switched on): each one raises the armour you get
  when you start a mission, restart from a checkpoint or respawn: 25%, 50%, 75%, then a full bar.
  It applies in Story, Arcade League, Behead The Undead and TimeSplitters 'Story' Classic.
* Weapon buffs, named like "Weapon Buff - Pistol 9mm - +25% Clip Size". Each copy adds that much
  of the normal value, up to three copies (two for Dispersion Gun Bullets Per Shot). The stats
  are Clip Size, Reserve Ammo, Reserve Grenades and, for the Dispersion Gun, Bullets Per Shot. They fill
  the locations left over after everything else, so a seed holds a random selection; the
  Dispersion Gun Bullets Per Shot and Injector Clip Size and Reserve Ammo buffs are always
  included. With every option on there are about 70 in a seed; with Include Weapon Buffs off the
  leftover locations hold "Nothing" items instead. A buff also applies to the weapon's (x2) version. The client's "Inventory" tab
  lists the ones you have.
* Progressive Damage Resistances (if Include Damage Resistances is on): Bullet, Explosive, Fire,
  Plasma and Melee, six of each. Each copy cuts the damage you take of that kind by 10%, up to
  60%. Enemies are not affected. Bullet covers pistols, rifles, SMGs, machine guns, shotguns, the
  Minigun, Harpoon Gun and Injector; Explosive every explosion (rockets, grenades, mines,
  barrels); Fire the Flamethrower and burning; Plasma the Dispersion Gun, Scifi Handgun, Scifi
  Sniper, Plasma Autorifle, Mag-Charger, ElectroTool and Ghost Gun; Melee punches, every weapon's
  melee swing, the Baseball Bat and the Brick. They go in the leftover locations before most
  weapon buffs, so a seed holds all 30 unless it is short of locations. Needs Dolphin's cheat
  codes to be off.
* Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum Trophy items (if the Archipelago Shop is on): 10, 20, 30 or 40
  shop points each (no real trophy). They take the place of every "Nothing", and a few are mixed
  in with the weapon buffs; Bronze is the most common, Platinum the rarest.
* Characters are named after the character. Characters and cheats only unlock from their items,
  never from the trophy or story level that normally unlocks them.

## Options

**Game Options**
* Starting Mission: a random Arcade League mission or Challenge (default), a random Arcade League
  mission, a random Challenge, a random story level, any of them, or Time To Split.
* How Many Starting Arcade/Challenge Missions (1 to 5) for the random Arcade/Challenge choices.
* Story Mode Status (individual levels or Progressive Story Level), Goal, Death Link, Streamer Mode.

**Goal Options - 1924 Future Perfect** (only with that goal)
* Story Levels Required To Access Goal, How Many Trophies Required To Access Goal, Minimum Grade
  Of Trophy To Count.

**Goal Options - Trophy Hunt** (only with that goal)
* Trophy Hunt Goal Setting (all Arcade League missions, all Challenges, or all 48), Trophy Grade
  Required For Goal, and Exclude Story Mode (story checks then only hold useful and filler items).

**Difficulty Settings**
* Exclude Hard Difficulty On Story Levels (on by default), Exclude All Platinum Trophies,
  Exclude Specific Platinum Trophies. Excluded locations only ever hold filler items.
* Easier Astro Jocks (Platinum 2:15, Gold 2:30, Silver 3:00), Easier Rumble In The Jungle
  (Platinum 3:15), Easier Cut-Out Shoot-Out Platinum Scores (Hart Attack 1775, Come Hell Or High
  Water 1700, Balls Of Steel 1200) and Quicker Electro Chimp Discomatic (Platinum 4:00, Gold 3:00,
  Silver 2:00, Bronze 1:00). These change what the game asks for, while the client is connected
  and from the next time the mission is loaded.

**Bonus Items**
* Progressive Starting Armour, Progressive Behead The Undead Score Multipliers and Progressive
  Miscellaneous Challenges Score Multipliers (each off, start with one, or shuffle all), an option
  for each multiplier to make one an early item, Include Weapon Buffs and Include Damage
  Resistances.

**Archipelago Shop**
* Include Archipelago Shop (on by default), How Many Shop Locations (15, 30, 45, 60 or 75) and
  Shop Hints (none, all, or progression only (default): which items are hinted when you open the
  shop).

**Milestone Locations**
* Four switches for the group, league and all-Challenges milestones.

## Streamer Mode
With Streamer Mode on, the licensed song in the Disco map and the credits is replaced with "Like
A Monkey", another track from the game. It applies while the client is connected, from the next
time that music starts.

## In-game announcements
While you play, the client shows Archipelago news in the game's own text at the bottom of the
screen: items you receive ("Received ... from ..."), items you send ("Sent ... to ...") and your own
items you find ("Found ..."). Death Links you receive show in large text in the middle. This works in
Story, Arcade League and Challenges. Messages that arrive while you are in the menus are not shown.

Type `/announce` in the client to see the settings, `/announce off` or `/announce on` to switch them
all, or for example `/announce sent off` or `/announce filler off` to hide one kind. Your choice is
remembered. Announcements need Dolphin's cheat codes to be off.

## Award screen
After a mission, the "New Feature Unlocked" screen also lists what you found at the locations you
checked, and what other players sent you, since the last time it was shown:
1. your story levels ("NEW STORY LEVEL AVAILABLE!", e.g. "2401 Time To Split"), arcade missions
   ("NEW MISSION AVAILABLE!") and challenges ("NEW CHALLENGE AVAILABLE!"),
2. your characters, weapons and cheats (listed by the game itself, as usual),
3. starting armour ("ARCHIPELAGO ITEM FOUND!"), score multipliers ("SCORE MULTIPLIER FOUND!",
   e.g. "Behead The Undead x2"), damage resistances ("DAMAGE RESISTANCE FOUND!", e.g. "Fire Damage
   30%") and weapon buffs ("RESERVE AMMO BUFF FOUND!", "CLIP SIZE BUFF FOUND!" and so on, e.g.
   "Plasma Autorifle 25%"), each showing the total you now have,
4. items for other players ("PLAYER'S ITEM!"): progression items first, then useful, traps and filler.
The mission or story level you have just played is not listed, even if its item arrived while you
were in the menus. The screen holds 10 entries. This needs Dolphin's cheat codes to be off, and the client connected to Dolphin before you
finish your first mission after starting the game.

## Archipelago Shop
With Include Archipelago Shop on, the main menu's "Extras" becomes "Extras & Shop", and its "View
Movies" becomes "Archipelago Shop" (movies can't be watched from there). The shop lists 15 items,
each with who it is for and its price, under your points. Press A on one to buy it: its location
is checked and the row reads "Purchased". Prices depend on the item: 1-5 points for filler and
traps, 5-75 for useful items, 15-200 for progression; a story level (of this game or
TimeSplitters 2) always costs at least 85.

Points come from:
* every kill, in any mode: 1 point;
* trophies in Arcade League missions and Challenges: Bronze 10, Silver 20, Gold 30, Platinum 40.
  A trophy also counts the ones below it, so a first Platinum is worth 100, and a Gold followed by
  a Platinum is 60 and then 40;
* story levels finished: Easy 15, Normal 35, Hard 50, counted the same way (100 for a first finish
  on Hard).
* Bronze / Silver / Gold / Platinum Trophy items: 10 / 20 / 30 / 40.
Kills count as you make them, while the client is connected to Dolphin. Points spent and kills are
kept on the Archipelago server, so they carry over between sessions.

With more than 15 shop locations, the rest come in batches of 15, each needing one more
"Progressive Shop Restock" item: when one arrives, every row shows its next item once the one
before it has been bought. The items a row shows are hinted when you open the shop, and when
buying brings up a row's next item (all of them, only progression items, or none, by the Shop
Hints option). What you buy is not listed on the award screen: not even a character, weapon or
cheat the game would otherwise show as newly unlocked.

Items for Future Perfect and TimeSplitters 2 players are shown with short names, in the shop and
on the award screen: a mission by its own name ("AL - Beginners Series - Adios Amigos!" is
"Adios Amigos!"), a weapon buff as "Pistols +25% Reserve Ammo", and a TimeSplitters 2 cartridge as
"Anaconda Cartridge". The shop
needs Dolphin's cheat codes to be off.

The client's "Inventory" tab shows the shop's items and your points (to look at; buying is done
in the game), and the damage resistances, weapon buffs, score multipliers and starting armour you
have.

## Death Link
With Death Link on, failing a mission sends a death to everyone else with it on: dying in a
Story level, failing a Story objective, or failing an Arcade League mission or Challenge. In
Arcade League missions you respawn when you die, so a death is sent every few deaths instead: the
Death Link Amnesty option (1 to 5, default 3) sets how many deaths in one mission send one
(1 = every death). The count starts again with every mission, including a restart. When someone
else's death arrives, you die in the mission you are playing, just as if you had been killed: in
Story levels and Challenges that fails the mission, in Arcade League missions you respawn. A death
you receive is never sent on and doesn't count towards Amnesty. Nothing happens if you are in the
menus or a custom Arcade match, or are already dead.
Finishing an Arcade League mission or Challenge below Bronze counts as failing it. Receiving
deaths needs Dolphin's cheat codes to be off.

## How it works

The client changes the game's own unlock rules in memory while it is connected, and one small
piece of the game's code so that story levels follow your items (when you beat a level, the game
only carries on into the next one if you have it; otherwise it returns to the menus). Your save
data is not changed, and everything goes back to normal when the game is restarted without the
client.

## Universal Tracker

If Universal Tracker is installed, the client shows its tracker tab and knows which checks are in
logic. No YAML is needed: it rebuilds the logic from the game you connect to.

tutorials.text:
# Setup Guide for TimeSplitters: Future Perfect Archipelago

## Requirements

* [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/) 0.6.0 or newer (tested on 0.6.3)
* The TimeSplitters Future Perfect `.apworld`
* [Dolphin Emulator](https://dolphin-emu.org/)
* TimeSplitters: Future Perfect for GameCube, North American version (game ID `G3FE69`). You must
  provide your own copy. Any format Dolphin can run should work as long as the game ID matches
  (ISO and NKit have been used; others are untested). The PAL, PlayStation 2 and Xbox versions
  are not supported.
* Optional: [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases?q=Tracker).
  It adds a tracker tab to the client listing the checks you can reach, which is the easiest way
  to see which mission you started with. Without it the client works the same, minus that tab.
* Optional: [Mouse & Keyboard Injector for Dolphin](https://github.com/CrashOveride95/MouseInjectorDolphin).

## Installing

1. Double-click the `.apworld` (or copy it into Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder) and restart
   the Archipelago Launcher.
2. In Dolphin, turn cheat codes off: Config > General > Enable Cheats. With them on, the Behead
   The Undead score multipliers and receiving Death Links do not work (the client log says so).

## Playing

1. Start Dolphin and the game, and open "TimeSplitters Future Perfect Client" from the Archipelago
   Launcher. The client says "Dolphin connected successfully."
2. Enter the server address at the top of the client, then your slot name at the bottom.
3. With the client open and connected, create a NEW save profile in the game. Use that profile
   for this seed only.
4. Keep the client open and connected to Dolphin while you play.

## Important notes

* **Connect the client before you load a profile or enter Story mode.** The client has to change
  how story levels unlock before the game first uses that part of its code. If you forget,
  restart the game with the client already open.
* **One profile per seed.** The client reads trophies and story completions from the profile you
  load and sends them all as checks. Loading a profile that already has progress sends every
  check tied to it, and a profile that has beaten 1924 Future Perfect finishes your game at once.
* **Do not play that profile without the client.** The game's normal unlocks come back when the
  client is not running, so the profile would gain things you have not received.
* **Story objectives are only seen as they happen.** An objective completed while the client is
  closed has to be completed again. Trophies and level completions are read from the save and
  are never missed.
* **After a crash:** your items and the checks already sent are safe, because the server keeps
  them. Anything the game had not saved (a trophy or a level completion) is missing from the
  profile, which matters for the 1924 Future Perfect requirements and the Trophy Hunt goal: earn it
  again.

readme.text:
# TimeSplitters: Future Perfect for Archipelago

An [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) world and Dolphin client for TimeSplitters: Future Perfect
(GameCube, North American version, game ID `G3FE69`), created by CaptPurpleHeart.

No game files are included; you need your own copy of the game. The PAL, PlayStation 2 and Xbox
versions are not supported.

## Download and setup

1. Download `timesplitters_future_perfect.apworld` from the
   [latest release](https://github.com/captpurpleheart/tsfp-archipelago/releases/latest).
2. Double-click it (or copy it into Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder) and restart the
   Archipelago Launcher.
3. Follow the [setup guide](timesplitters_future_perfect/docs/en_Setup.md).

The [game page](timesplitters_future_perfect/docs/en_TimeSplitters%20Future%20Perfect.md) describes
every item, check and option.

## Support

For help, discussion and bug reports, join the TimeSplitters Archipelago Discord:
https://discord.gg/M9cbCqc8sF

## What the randomizer does

* **Items:** all 48 Arcade League missions and Challenges, the 13 story levels (or Progressive Story
  Levels), all 150 characters, the 13 cheats and 34 arcade weapons, optional bonus items (Progressive
  Starting Armour, Progressive Behead The Undead Score Multiplier, Progressive Miscellaneous
  Challenges Score Multiplier), Progressive Damage Resistances, Progressive Shop Restocks, Trophy
  items for shop points, and weapon buffs filling the leftover locations.
* **Locations:** Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum trophies on every mission, story level completions per
  difficulty, story objectives, optional group/league/all-Challenges milestones, and the optional
  Archipelago Shop.
* **Goals:** complete 1924 Future Perfect (optionally needing a number of story levels and trophies
  first), or a Trophy Hunt: a chosen grade of trophy on every Arcade League mission, every Challenge,
  or all 48.
* **Easier trophies (optional):** easier times for Astro Jocks, Rumble In The Jungle and Electro Chimp
  Discomatic, and lower Platinum scores for the Cut-Out Shoot-Out Challenges.
* **Death Link:** failing a mission sends a death; a death received kills you in the mission you are in.
  In Arcade League missions, Death Link Amnesty (1 to 5) sets how many deaths send one.
* **In-game announcements:** items you receive, send and find appear as on-screen text while you
  play, and received Death Links in large text. Use `/announce` in the client to choose which.
* **Archipelago Shop:** Extras & Shop > Archipelago Shop sells 15 to 75 items for points earned from
  kills, trophies and story levels.
* **Inventory tab:** the client lists the shop's items and your points, and the damage resistances,
  weapon buffs, score multipliers and starting armour you have.
* **Award screen:** after a mission, the "New Feature Unlocked" screen also lists the story levels,
  missions, challenges, bonus items and other players' items you found or received.
* **Streamer Mode:** replaces the licensed Disco and credits song with another track from the game.
* **Universal Tracker** is supported when installed (optional).

## Building from source

Run `py build_apworld.py` to make `timesplitters_future_perfect.apworld` from the
`timesplitters_future_perfect/` folder.

## License

MIT. See `LICENSE`.

notes.text:
## New Features
- **Archipelago Shop** - A Shop has been added in-game! The "View Movies" menu in Extras has been turned into a Shop where you can spend points on Archipelago Items! Extras has been renamed to "Extras & Shop", and "View Movies" has been renamed to "Archipelago Shop". The Shop holds 15 items, and items are priced based on their item type (Progression/Useful/Filler/Trap). Depending on how many Shop Locations (Max 75) you've chosen in your YAML, "Progressive Shop Restock" items are added to into the Item Pool. When you purchase an item, it gets sent to the player, and replaces that line with "Purchased". If you have a Shop Restock item, any "Purchased" line gets replaced with the next in-line item to buy. You can earn points by the following methods:
> 1. Getting Kills in any mode, counted as you make them, 1 Kill = 1 Point.
> 2. Earning Trophies in Arcade/Challenges, worth 10/20/30/40, counting the lower grades
> 3. Completing Story Levels based on difficulty 15/35/50, counting the easier difficulties
> 4. New Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum Trophy Filler Items.
- **Progressive Damage Resistances** - 5 Resistance types, Bullet, Explosive, Fire, Plasma and Melee. 6 of each, adding 10% Resistance of that type.
- **Familiarity with TimeSplitters 2** - Items for TimeSplitters 2 are recognised by TimeSplitters: Future Perfect, and will have shortened names in the Awards Screen & Shop. So instead of "Challenge - Behead the Undead - Sergio's Last Stand", it will show as "Sergio's Last Stand" in the Awards Screen & Shop.
> *Must be TimeSplitters 2 (PurpleHeart's Version)*
- **Inventory Tab** - Weapon Buffs tab has been renamed to "Inventory Tab", which shows a Read-Only view of all items in the Shop and how many Points you have. It shows all your Resistances, Damage Buffs, Score Multipliers and Progressive Starting Armour.
- **Award Screen Changes** - New Headers such as "RESERVE AMMO BUFF FOUND!", "CLIP SIZE BUFF FOUND!", "SCORE MULTIPLIER FOUND!", "DAMAGE RESISTANCE FOUND!" to reduce the amount of text on the awards screen. Story Levels now include their Year in their name.
